source: NCO.zip — letters exchanged between RCRC and RTCC-IC ICTAS JV (NCO #1 to #6)

events.title: Omission of Bridge Deck Waterproof Membrane
events.clause: Terms of the Contract Section 5 Cl. 14 (Contractor: Article 16 — amendment of the Contract)
events.scope: The waterproof membrane on the bridge decks is removed from the Contract scope (all junction bridges).
events.summary: Started from the Contractor's RFI on the deck surface waterproofing system (Nov 2025). WSP answered in CRS-00096 (code E) that deck waterproofing is not required and the item will be deleted. RCRC then served NCO #1, effective immediately, asking for the schedule impact and a revised BOQ. The Contractor assessed the change as time-neutral (affected activities are non-critical / within float) and cost-reductive: SAR 9,285,420 excl. VAT off the Contract Price. RCRC questioned the Contractor's reservation on overheads / loss of profit (Government Tenders and Procurement Law, Art. 69: change orders up to +10% / −20%); the Contractor clarified the reservation is not a claim and that no time or additional financial claim will be submitted.
events.time: Time-neutral — no EOT (confirmed by the Contractor on 21 Jan 2026 and 04 Feb 2026)
events.costNote: Reduction of the Contract Price, SAR excl. VAT (revised BOQ, LET-00036)
events.next: RCRC to issue the formal Change Order reflecting the reduction of SAR 9,285,420.

letters.subject: Bridges Deck Surface Waterproofing System
letters.action: Contractor's request for information on the deck waterproofing system. WSP reply CRS-00096 (04 Dec 2025, code E — no action required): deck waterproofing is not required and the item will be deleted; a formal instruction to follow.

letters.subject: Deletion of the Waterproofing Works of Bridge Deck
letters.action: Acknowledges the deletion confirmed by the CRS, accepts it under Article 16 and announces a review of any technical, financial or schedule implications.

letters.subject: NCO # 1 - Omission of Bridge Deck Waterproof Membrane
letters.action: Notice of Change Order, effective immediately. Contractor to submit (i) any anticipated schedule impact and (ii) a revised BOQ.

letters.subject: Response to NCO #1 – Omission of Bridge Deck Waterproof Membrane
letters.action: Acknowledges the instruction; schedule impact: none (time-neutral, activities non-critical / within float); revised BOQ: reduction of SAR 9,285,420 excl. VAT, reflected in the PMR; reserves rights on overheads / loss of profit.

letters.subject: Response to NCO #1 Omission of Bridge Deck Waterproof Membrane
letters.action: Asks for the legal and regulatory basis of the reservation on overheads / loss of profit, citing Art. 69 of the Government Tenders and Procurement Law.

letters.subject: Contractual Clarification Regarding the Reservation Stated in the Contractor's Correspondence – NCO No. (1)
letters.action: The reservation is precautionary only — not a claim. Confirms the omission is time-neutral and reflected solely as a reduction of the Contract value, without any time-related or additional financial claim.

events.title: Changing Bearing Type from POT to SPHERICAL
events.clause: Terms of the Contract Section 5 Cl. 14 and SCC Cl. 6.2
events.status: Contractor's cost-neutral proposal submitted — awaiting RCRC; time impact assessment due
events.scope: All Section C bridges at Junction 1 (C15+100), Junction 3 (C10+600), Junction 5 (C7+300), Junction 7 (C4+050) and the seven pedestrian bridges: bearings change from POT to SPHERICAL.
events.summary: The approved specification named POT bearings and the Contractor had started their studies and procurement. After a verbal instruction to use spherical bearings, the Contractor suspended the POT activities, started the spherical design and asked for a formal written instruction (bearings are a long-lead item). RCRC served NCO #2 the same day, asking for cost (Contract BOQ rates, new rates substantiated, incl. 15% VAT) and time implications. The Contractor accepted: POT items omitted (SAR 9,745,332.32 excl. VAT) and spherical bearings offered at the same value in good faith, i.e. cost-neutral, while reserving EOT / prolongation / disruption rights — a detailed time impact assessment to follow.
events.time: EOT rights reserved — time impact assessment (TIA) to be submitted
events.costNote: Cost-neutral proposal: POT omitted SAR 9,745,332.32 = SPHERICAL added SAR 9,745,332.32 (excl. VAT)
events.next: RCRC to accept the cost-neutral proposal; Contractor to submit the spherical bearing submittals and the time impact assessment.

letters.subject: Request for Formal Instruction Regarding Bearing Type (Pot vs. Spherical Bearing)
letters.action: Specification = POT; a verbal instruction asked for spherical, so POT work was suspended and spherical design started. Requests a formal written instruction; procurement cannot proceed and delays until then are outside the Contractor's responsibility.

letters.subject: NCO # 2 - Changing Bearing Type from POT to SPHERICAL
letters.action: Notice of Change Order for J1, J3, J5, J7 bridges and the seven pedestrian bridges. Contractor to submit cost and time implications (BOQ rates, new rates substantiated, incl. 15% VAT).

letters.subject: NCO No. 2 – Bearing Type Change (POT to SPHERICAL)
letters.action: Acknowledges and complies. POT items omitted SAR 9,745,332.32 excl. VAT; spherical bearings proposed at the same value (cost-neutral, good faith). Submittals to follow; EOT / prolongation / disruption rights reserved; detailed TIA to follow. Attachment: BOQ — omitted POT bearing items.

events.title: Omission of the MV and HV/EHV Duct Banks
events.clause: Terms of the Contract Section 5 Cl. 14
events.status: Contractor's response (schedule impact and revised BOQ) under preparation
events.scope: Omission of the underground duct bank corridors proposed for the SEC diversions along Taif Road, with their manholes: 6×150 mm PVC duct bank for MV cable and 4×150 mm PVC duct bank for HV/EHV cable, longitudinally under the roads.
events.summary: Part of the dry-utilities redesign. Before the NCO the Contractor had asked RCRC (18 Mar 2026) to choose between the IFC design, the PMCM-modified design or a consolidated alternative for the HV / MV / LV / ITS / MONG duct banks, and sent a reminder on 18 Apr 2026 after the 30 Mar 2026 coordination meeting and RCRC's 02 Apr 2026 e-mail — LV, MONG, street lighting, MOI and CCTV networks and the Section D interface (KM 0) could not progress. RCRC served NCO #3 (effective immediately) omitting the MV and HV/EHV duct banks and asking for the schedule impact and a revised BOQ. On 06 May 2026 the Contractor replied that its NCO #3 review is ongoing and its position will follow separately, and that shop drawings need complete IFC drawings. The LV / ITS / street-lighting part was then covered by NCO #5 and NCO #6.
events.next: Contractor to submit the schedule impact and the revised BOQ for the omitted MV and HV/EHV duct banks.

letters.subject: Request for Client Final Decision and Instruction for HV, MV, LV, ITS, and MONG ductbank line
letters.action: Instructed changes deviate from the IFC design and cause delay and rework. Asks RCRC to choose Option A (IFC design), B (PMCM-modified design) or C (consolidated alternative); any deviation from IFC = Variation Order with time / cost entitlement.

letters.subject: Reminder – Final Decision Required for Dry Utilities Modifications (HV/MV/LV/ITS/MONG)
letters.action: After the 30 Mar 2026 meeting and RCRC's 02 Apr 2026 e-mail, still no formal instruction: LV, MONG, street lighting, MOI, CCTV networks and the Section D interface (KM 0) are on hold. Requests an urgent formal decision; time / cost rights reserved.

letters.subject: NCO # 3 - Omission of the MV and HV/EHV Duct Banks
letters.action: Notice of Change Order, effective immediately: omission of the 6×150 mm MV and 4×150 mm HV/EHV duct banks with their manholes (SEC diversions). Contractor to submit the schedule impact and a revised BOQ.

letters.subject: Shop drawings and coordination works (referenced in LET-00096 — letter not in the pack)
letters.action: RCRC letter on the preparation of shop drawings and coordination works for the modified utilities.

letters.subject: Contractual Response Regarding Shop Drawings, IFC Drawing Completeness, and Ongoing Change Order Review (NCO #3)
letters.action: Accepts the shop-drawing obligation but it needs complete, coordinated IFC drawings; the 02 Apr 2026 changes are additional (NCOs to be issued). NCO #3 review ongoing — position to follow in a separate letter. Work continues to mitigate delay, without accepting it as original scope; rights reserved.

events.title: Design Modification of the Tender Irrigation System
events.clause: Terms of the Contract Section 5 Cl. 14 and SCC Cl. 6.2 (Contractor also cites SCC 6.3, 6.6 and GCC 61, 64)
events.status: Waiting for the existing Amanah tank data — final configuration, time and cost on hold
events.scope: Redesign of the tender irrigation system (irrigation tanks, pump rooms, distribution network) and a new TSE feeding line with a pump room from Green Riyadh's proposed tank at Exit 34 interchange to the existing Amanah tanks 16, 64, 67 and the TRQR Section D tank. Amanah tanks 64 and 67 with their pumps become intermediate pumping stations.
events.summary: RCRC served NCO #4 to rework the irrigation system around the Green Riyadh TSE supply: the Contractor must coordinate with Amanah, verify the complete system and propose a revised configuration, with cost and time implications (BOQ rates, incl. 15% VAT). The Contractor acknowledged, confirmed it has started the studies and coordination, and stated that the final configuration — and therefore the final time and cost assessment — depends on the operational and technical data of the existing Amanah tanks, which RCRC requested from Amanah by letter 20260402079 (02 Apr 2026). Any assessment now is preliminary; all rights reserved.
events.time: Rights reserved (SCC 6.6, GCC 64) — final assessment after the tank data
events.costNote: Preliminary — depends on the final system configuration
events.next: RCRC to obtain and forward the Amanah tank data; Contractor to propose the revised irrigation configuration with cost and time.

letters.subject: RCRC request to Amanah for the existing irrigation tank information (referenced in LET-00102)
letters.action: RCRC formally asked Amanah for the operational and technical data of the existing tanks.

letters.subject: NCO # 4 - Design Modification of the Tender Irrigation System
letters.action: Notice of Change Order: irrigation tanks, pump rooms, distribution network and the TSE feeding line from Exit 34 to Amanah tanks 16, 64, 67 and the TRQR Section D tank. Contractor to coordinate with Amanah, propose the revised configuration and submit cost and time implications.

letters.subject: NCO #4 – Irrigation System Modification, Pending Technical Information
letters.action: Acknowledges; the change modifies the fundamental configuration of the tender system. Studies and coordination started; final verification, configuration and time / cost assessment depend on the Amanah tank data. Any current estimate is preliminary; rights reserved under SCC 6.2, 6.3, 6.6 and GCC 61, 64.

events.title: Construction of RCC Concrete Duct Bank under the Road Crossing — ITS and Telecommunications
events.status: Contractor's technical study, cost and time implications required
events.scope: The ITS duct bank design and duct sizes are revised to comply with the ITS Network Unification Program — RCC concrete duct bank under the road crossings for ITS and telecommunications.
events.summary: Following discussions with the Contractor, RCRC served NCO #5 so that the ITS network matches the approved program standards and stays uniform across the program. The Contractor must submit a comprehensive technical study with the cost and time implications, fully substantiated (Contract BOQ rates, new rates substantiated, incl. 15% VAT). RCRC reserves the right to further assess the viability of this NCO. No Contractor response is in the pack.
events.time: To be submitted by the Contractor
events.costNote: To be submitted (technical study + cost + time)
events.next: Contractor to submit the technical study, cost and time implications.

letters.subject: NCO # 05 - Construction of RCC Concrete Duct Bank Under the Road Crossing ITS and Telecommunications
letters.action: Notice of Change Order: ITS duct bank design and duct sizes revised to the ITS Network Unification Program. Contractor to submit a comprehensive technical study with cost and time implications; RCRC may further assess its viability.

events.title: Re-arrangement of Street Lighting and LV Corridors, and Changes to LV Cable Types
events.status: Contractor's technical study, cost and time implications required
events.scope: The LV duct banks are relocated into the proposed street-lighting corridor and used as one combined LV + street-lighting corridor; LV cable types change.
events.summary: To comply with the project requirements and approved standards and to optimise the corridor layout at lower cost, RCRC revised the corridor plan: one combined LV / street-lighting duct bank instead of two, reducing infrastructure redundancy. The Contractor must submit a comprehensive technical study with the cost and time implications, fully substantiated. RCRC reserves the right to further assess the viability of this NCO. No Contractor response is in the pack.
events.time: To be submitted by the Contractor
events.costNote: To be submitted (technical study + cost + time)
events.next: Contractor to submit the technical study, cost and time implications.

letters.subject: NCO # 06 - Re-Arrangement of Street Lighting and LV Corridors, and Changes to LV Cable Types
letters.action: Notice of Change Order: LV duct banks relocated to the street-lighting corridor as a combined LV / lighting corridor; LV cable types change. Contractor to submit a comprehensive technical study with cost and time implications; RCRC may further assess its viability.
